release_notes: `reconciliation.py`: `reconcile()` checked every active strategy's legs against a single global broker (`broker.get_broker()`, env-var selected, default kite), so a strategy configured for Breeze/Dhan was silently compared to Kite's `positions()` and its real, correctly-held legs always read as orphan (`state active, broker empty`). Confirmed live 2026-08-31: a genuinely open Breeze diagonal long leg flagged as mismatched purely because reconcile only ever asked Kite. `reconcile()` now takes `{broker_name: (client, error)}` and checks each strategy's legs against its own configured broker; `app.py` builds one client per broker actually in use instead of a single `get_broker()` call, and the token-freshness gates now pass if ANY used broker is fresh rather than one env-selected broker.
